pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Divine Gold is a collab material from $(l:https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/goety-revelation)Goety Revelation$()$(li)Melt a $(bold)Broken Halo$() (goety_revelation:broken_halo, from the broken Halo of the End / Revelation rituals) into $(bold)Holy Fall$() (90 mB each, temperature 1200); the $(bold)Halo of Ascension$() (goety_revelation:ascension_halo) melts richer — $(bold)120 mB$()$(li)At the Casting Table, pour $(bold)90 mB$() of $(bold)Holy Fall$() onto a $(bold)Dark Metal$() part to cast a Divine Gold part — Dark Metal is the base, Holy Fall the molten boost$(li)It is a $(bold)T4$() material (netherite mining level) and requires the Goety Revelation add-on$(br2)Note: this material is hidden from the Creative inventory when the Goety/Revelation add-on is not installed.

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(bold)Soul Mending$()$(default): spend soul energy to restore durability$(li)$(bold)Laevatain$()$(melee): true-damage pierce + heal-block + max-health cut$(li)$(bold)Divine Power$()$(melee): imbue magic containers with a mana aura$(li)$(bold)Gungnir$()$(ranged): projectiles inflict Stun/Burn Hex on hit$(li)$(bold)Returning$()$(ranged): arrows return to the wielder$(li)$(bold)Godrealm Overstep$()$(armor): immune to fire/explosion/magic damage$(li)$(bold)Heaven & Earth Forged$()$(armor): cap incoming damage$(li)$(bold)Soul Discount$()$(armor): reduced soul cost when casting$(br2)Divine Gold is a top-tier all-round collab material covering melee, ranged and armor.
